meta.name: founder-scope-challenge
meta.description: Stress-test a founder's plan, brutally, before they spend weeks on it. Trigger on "challenge my plan", "is this plan right", "stress test this", "push back on this", "am I doing too much", "is this enough", "talk me out of this", or any moment a founder wants the plan attacked rather than approved. Runs one of three modes on the plan: Expand (too small, name what is missing), Hold (right-sized, defend it against the next shiny thing), or Reduce (bloated, cut to the one move that reaches a customer). Brutal on the plan, never on the person. Anchored to one test: does this get the founder to a paying customer faster. Free-tier, reads files only.
